name: helium_bottle_lox_displacement
title: Helium bottle pushing liquid oxygen at constant pressure (rocket exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise: a helium bottle pushes 5000 kg of liquid oxygen towards the engine pump of a rocket at a constant 100 kPa. The model computes the LOX tank volume, the isobaric boundary work of the helium and, from the two helium states (20 °C/14 MPa and -75 °C/100 kPa), the mass of helium and the required bottle volume.
